meta.title: Memecoin lifecycle: from Genesis to steady state

transitions.label: Fast Genesis: met before deadline, triggers early
Lock-up ends; anyone triggers unified settlement
Protection window ends, auto-resume
transitions.note: Public trading resumes; no transaction needed

cards.title: Either threshold suffices
items: Standard Genesis capital and leverage interest are each compared independently against the minimum success threshold
The two are never added together; either one meeting the threshold makes Genesis succeed
Preorder funds and leverage debt principal do not count toward the threshold

cards.title: Phase advances are transaction-triggered
items: Apart from the protection window's automatic resume, every phase advance takes a public transaction to trigger
Unlock time = Genesis deadline + 365 days (fixed); entering Locked early does not change it
The 24-hour protection window counts from the transaction that actually enters Unlocked

cards.title: Two exits
items: Either threshold met: enters Locked, four pools deployed
Neither threshold met: enters Refund, everything refunded in full, no one loses principal
Steady state is the terminal state after unlock completes
